tiers.use_for: Short, read-only lookups: locate files and symbols, list usages, read a config, extract facts from a small set of files.
tiers.rationale: Cheapest tier. Haiku at low effort is suited to short tool tasks but more likely to skip checks in long prompts, so scouts get short, closed questions only.

tiers.use_for: Mechanical, fully specified changes: boilerplate, tests from an explicit spec, docs, renames, formatting, data transformation.
tiers.rationale: Haiku at medium (its default) is the documented starting point for most work including agentic coding, at 1/20 of Sonnet's per-token price.

tiers.use_for: Well-specified features and bug fixes with a known cause, multi-file edits inside one module.
tiers.rationale: Sonnet guidance: start at medium for well-specified agentic coding.

tiers.use_for: Harder or longer implementation, cross-module changes, debugging with partial information.
tiers.rationale: Sonnet guidance: move to high for harder or longer tasks.

tiers.use_for: Architecture and design decisions, security-sensitive changes, unknown root causes in high-risk code or after a lower tier failed, work where a wrong call is expensive.
tiers.rationale: Reserved for judgment-heavy work; effort set explicitly because Opus 5.5 defaults to medium.
